leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a grid container using CSS Grid layout.
Configure the grid to use auto-fit for responsive column creation.
Apply the minmax() function to define flexible column widths.
Manipulate grid gap properties to control spacing between cards.
Integrate card content within grid items for a structured layout.
Initialize media queries to adjust grid behavior across viewport sizes.
Render a fully responsive card grid that adapts to available space.
